MP Pappu Yadav enters Parliament in priestly attire, sparks protest

Pappu Yadav, the Member of Parliament from Purnea, entered Parliament dressed in saffron robes, resembling a priest. This act led to protests, including the burning of his effigy in Lucknow by the Vishwa Hindu Raksha Parishad. A complaint was also filed against him at the Jahangirpuri police station in Delhi.
